comment: Languages visit.ee can be built in. The source language has no URL prefix; every other language lives under /<prefix>/. A language is built only when enabled, and it then needs every UI string the source has (i18n/ui/<code>.json). A site is built in a language only when its own strings are complete in it. Every place needs a description in each of place_descriptions (i18n/places/<code>.json); in any other language a site is built in, a missing one is a warning.
